tokens.name: pink-100
tokens.usage: Soft pink tint. Selected pills, icon tiles, date tiles, info banners. Text on it: pink-700 or ink.

tokens.name: pink-200
tokens.usage: Outline of secondary buttons. Border only, never text.

tokens.name: pink-300
tokens.usage: Light pink accent used on ink or on pink-500 grounds: initials on ink avatars, status dots, ink court diagrams.

tokens.name: pink-400
tokens.usage: Decorative circle on pink-500 surfaces (hero headers, feature card). No text.

tokens.name: pink-500
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Primary buttons, selected states, map pins, switches, hero surfaces. White text on it passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: pink-600
tokens.usage: Deeper pink for decorative circles and chips sitting on pink-500. White text on it passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: pink-700
tokens.usage: Pink for text and icons on white or pink-100 (links, small labels, selected pill text). Passes 4.5:1 on both.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the near-black used for avatars, status tags and dark buttons.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text, inactive tab labels and icons, unselected pill text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions and metadata on white or surface-soft. Passes 4.5:1 on both.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and card fill. Screens are white.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet grey-pink fill for neutral badges, inset tiles and disabled controls.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline border of cards and row dividers on white.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Border of unselected pills and icon buttons. Non-text boundary.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Border of text inputs, checkboxes, radios and the off state of a switch. Passes 3:1 on white.

tokens.name: amber-100
tokens.usage: Pending status ground (banner, badge).

tokens.name: amber-600
tokens.usage: Pending status icon stroke.

tokens.name: amber-800
tokens.usage: Text on amber-100.

tokens.name: green-100
tokens.usage: Success status ground (banner, badge).

tokens.name: green-600
tokens.usage: Success status icon stroke.

tokens.name: green-800
tokens.usage: Text on green-100.

tokens.name: error-100
tokens.usage: Ground for an error banner or inline error block.

tokens.name: error-600
tokens.usage: Error text, icon and field border. Passes 4.5:1 on white and on error-100. Always paired with an icon and a message, never colour alone.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Level number on the pink level card.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headings above cards. Sentence case.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Text typed into inputs. 16px stops mobile browsers zooming in on focus.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Friendly, social match. Good vibes and balanced play.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Waiting for Carlos M. to confirm

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase tags on pink surfaces and date tiles. Uppercase in markup.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its icon in tab bars.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pills and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked buttons and between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, section gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sheet top padding, large gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Primary button side padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon tiles and date tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Banners, inset tiles, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, hero sheets and the feature card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, badges, tab bar. Fully round ends.

tokens.name: shadow-brand
tokens.usage: Primary button only. Gives the one hot action a glow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating tab bar and floating search.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on a soft grey ground. On white, use a line border instead.
